hook: Peace talks collapsed in Moscow when Pakistan and the Taliban clashed over border security.

sections.voiceover: Peace talks collapsed in Moscow when Pakistan and the Taliban clashed over border security.
b_roll: Map of Moscow featuring conference hall

sections.voiceover: Minister Amir Khan Muttaqi walked out of the eighth Moscow Format Consultations. Fighting erupted immediately across southeastern Paktia province and Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. Where did 1,100 civilian casualties come from?
Pakistan declared a state of emergency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as security tensions escalated.
Border clashes between Pakistan and the Taliban led to the declaration of a state of emergency.
